{{Top}}
'''Grain''' was a type of flora that was used in the cultivation of certain [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]]. Types of grain included [[Ebla grain]], [[Tikit grain]], and [[Quinto grain]]. Some grains could even be used to make [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] like [[Ebla beer/Legends|Ebla beer]] and [[Bothan grain wine]]. Various pests that fed on grain crops included the [[Sacorrian grain fly]].
